name: Pi
description: Minimal, extensible coding agent harness for the terminal that you customise with extensions, skills and prompt templates.
whatItDoes: Pi is a deliberately small coding agent that developers shape to their own workflow rather than a batteries-included product. It handles reading, editing and running code in a project. It can also be scripted or embedded in other tools.
howItWorks: A compact core loop exposes a few basic tools, and everything else is added through extensions and skills. It runs interactively, in a print or JSON mode, over RPC, or through an SDK. There is no built-in permission system, so isolation is left to the user.

requirements.name: Node.js 22.19+
requirements.description: Needed for the npm install route
